card.name: "Sign of" before hypersensitivity in rash warnings
card.fires_on: The word "of" (sometimes "sign" or "signs") in the phrase "skin rash or any other sign of hypersensitivity". It appears in NSAID warnings about stopping the drug at the first appearance of rash.

modes.label: "of" after sign
modes.description: The word "of" right after "any other sign" and before "hypersensitivity" in skin reaction warnings.
modes.example: discontinue the use of piroxicam capsules at the first appearance of skin rash or any other sign<< of>> hypersensitivity.

modes.label: "sign" or "signs" itself
modes.description: The word "sign" or "signs" just before "of hypersensitivity" in the same warning.
modes.example: at first appearance of skin rash or other<< signs>> of hypersensitivity and consider further evaluation.

card.plain: It marks the fixed warning phrase about stopping the drug at the first rash or other sign of hypersensitivity.
